summary: Intellia Therapeutics filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a $150M underwritten common stock offering under Rule 424(b)(5). The offering is a shelf takedown of shares priced at the prevailing market price ($15.87 per share as of April 23, 2026). Underwriters include Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, and Citigroup, with a 30-day option for additional shares. This is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes. No special-situation mechanics or catalysts apply.
